def: OpenAI's open-source agent framework for Python and TypeScript with agents, handoffs, agents as tools, guardrails, sessions, tracing, voice agents and sandboxed workspaces; still pre-1.0 as of November 2026.
practice: Tracing is on by default, sends data to OpenAI and is unavailable under zero data retention, so replace the trace processors if traces must stay in your own stack.
